page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.14xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 56 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 224.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance tradeoff between single-core and multi-core execution. Single-core metrics, such as the stress-ng single-core CPU performance and Geekbench single-core score, fall into the weak category (bottom 25%). Similarly, single-threaded operations like gzip compression are poor (bottom 10%). However, the instance leverages its 56 dedicated cores to achieve average (middle 50%) performance in multi-core benchmarks, including stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth also remains consistently in the average tier, with read-only small block cached speeds reaching 2284.31 GB/sec.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn2ne.14xlarge offers a high density of dedicated physical cores and memory capacity, making it a viable option for workloads that scale horizontally across many threads without requiring the highest single-thread performance. It is well-suited for multi-threaded database operations, software compilation, static web serving, and moderate LLM inference tasks, such as prompt processing with 7B models.
